stories.title: The Drunkard of Kol Nidrei
stories.shareText:
*The Drunkard of Kol Nidrei*

Erev Yom Kippur. The shul is packed, the Aron Kodesh opens for Kol Nidrei, and suddenly a man asleep in the corner, in dirty clothes and smelling strongly of vodka, wakes up. He climbs onto the bimah and announces... the Simchat Torah hakafot!
Everyone wanted to throw him out. But the Alter Rebbe said: "Leave him be."

How did Reb Shmuel end up like that, on the eve of the holiest day of the year? The full story will surprise you.

A true story for bedtime. Listen together 🎧
Listen: https://abrahamgersten.github.io/zeh-kara-beemet/en/s/kol-nidrei-drunkard/

Enjoyed the story? Share it with family and friends ❤️

stories.shareText:
*A Debt of Gratitude*

Rav Isser Zalman Meltzer, Rosh Yeshivah of Etz Chaim, was so old and weak that he hardly ever left his home.
Then, at the bar mitzvah of a simple family, everyone sees him climbing the stairs to the hall, step after step, with great effort. The boy's father is stunned: "What did I ever do for the Rav?"

The Rav's answer will change the way you think about every "thank you."

"What happened?" he asked in alarm.
